newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Fisher Scientific started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fisher Scientific started.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston said on Wednesday it initiated coverage of Fisher Scientific International Inc with a hold rating.
-- Analyst Robert Willoughby said in a research note his 1997 earnings estimate before one-time charges was $2.75 per share and his 1998 earnings estimate was $3.25 per share.
-- "We believe that upside for investors from its current level remains relatively modest, and pending clarification of the offer and further information, we are neutral on the stock," he said.
-- On June 4, Fisher received an unsolicited bid from its largest shareholder for as much as $48 per share, he said.
-- Its shares were trading up 1/8 at 44-7/8.
